notable_absence.finding: Despite raising the ISGR/XDCR comparison three separate times (architecture-level 'similarly...However', the collection-mapping adaptation, and the footnote about combining one-directional XDCR with Sync Gateway), the page never uses a clean, formal disambiguation predicate like shouldNotBeConfusedWith or hasNoRelationshipTo to settle the question either way. Each mention stops short of asserting identity OR asserting total independence - it argues for shared lineage/adapted mechanism while insisting on operational distinctness. This is exactly the kind of source text the no-silent-merge rule anticipates: a human reconciliation call is needed, not an extraction-layer inference.

cross_component_finding: This is the strongest ISGR/XDCR evidence surfaced anywhere in the corpus so far, and it directly stress-tests round 27's near-miss call. Three distinct statements on one page: (1) 'Couchbase Server uses the Cross Data Center Replication API (XDCR) similarly to replicate between Couchbase Server clusters. However, inter-Sync Gateway replication feature is specifically designed for Sync Gateway deployments and must be used for replication between mobile clusters.' - draws the parallel and then immediately fences it off; (2) 'This collection mapping capability adapts the mapping concept from XDCR for Sync Gateway deployments.' - a concrete, mechanism-level borrowing claim, the clearest ISGR-to-XDCR statement found in this project to date; (3) footnote 2: 'If one-directional XDCR is used alongside Sync Gateway, then Sync Gateway cluster must be in read-only mode.' - an operational coexistence constraint implying the two mechanisms can be run against the same data simultaneously, with XDCR write access taking precedence. None of these three statements say ISGR and XDCR are the same mechanism or should share a concept id - if anything, statement (1) argues explicitly for keeping them apart at the product level. But statement (2) is a genuine, source-stated relationship (an isAnalogousTo edge between sgw:collection-mapping and xdcr:explicit-mapping) that the registry did not previously have, and reconciliation should decide how much weight it carries, especially set against round 27's absence-based argument from configuration-schema-isgr.md and this same batch's other four pages, which never mention XDCR at all (see conflict-resolution.json's notable_absence for the sharpest contrast: the ISGR page about conflict resolution - the one topic where XDCR's own Sequence-Number/Timestamp vocabulary would be most natural to invoke - says nothing about XDCR).
cross_product_finding: sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication usesProtocol the same websocket protocol as Couchbase Lite 2.x replication - a genuine cross-product (Sync Gateway / Couchbase Lite) technical identity, distinct from and unrelated to the XDCR question above. Also, footnote 1 (ship-to-shore / hub-and-spoke architecture) reuses networking topology vocabulary without further product comparison, not flagged as a finding.
